discrepancies.transcribed: instructions: Rate each of the following statements on a scale of 1 ("not at all typical of me") to 5 ("very typical of me"). Please do not leave any items blank.
discrepancies.source: Enter the number that best describes how typical or characteristic each item is of you, putting the number next to each item.

notes: The stated primary source (NIHR Journals Library appendix PDF) could not be fetched; both attempts returned a reCAPTCHA page. The Hachette book reproduction was used as the 1 alternative. Against it all 16 items are present in the same order with the same meaning, items 2, 4, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15 and 16 match word for word, and the reverse keyed set (items 1, 3, 8, 10, 11, marked (R)) matches the file. The 8 wording discrepancies are contraction and punctuation variants (don't/do not, shouldn't/should not, can't/cannot, I'm/I am, I've/I have, 'nothing more that I can do', 'any more' versus 'anymore', comma placement in items 5 and 6). The transcriptionNote already flags that contraction and 'any more' variants exist between reproductions, so these may reflect the book's edition rather than transcription errors; the file's uncontracted wording should be re-checked against the NIHR appendix or Meyer et al. (1990) before any wording is changed. The alternative also prints a middle anchor 'Somewhat typical' at 3 and omits 'of me', and its instruction wording differs from the file's. The licence quotes match the CamCOPS page: 'In the public domain.', 'Reproduced in full in Meyer et al. (1990).' and the Borkovec personal communication to Rudolf Cardinal dated 2015-07-23 (the file renders the date as 23 July 2015 and lightly paraphrases 'with explicit permission given for use here').
